segments.quote_anchor: Find the movers. Find the most volatile ones. Keep 70%. Lather, rinse, repeat. Preserve emotional resilience. Do not pay attention to news or anything. Just trade the couple patterns and whatevers that you got.

segments.label: Study Eric Mo: 10 months in a row of no losing weeks, almost boring
segments.status: MINED 2026-11-22 (VTT 01:51:39.9 'What I really want you to do' to 01:52:18.5 'where I want you to be.'); the twin s12a carries it
segments.quote_anchor: What I really want you to do is study Eric Mo in cohort four. He's had 10 months in a row of no losing weeks. Trading exactly this way with about a dozen symbols... 60 to 70% win rate in a given month and a payoff of 3 to one... it's almost boring for him, which is where I want you to be.
